name: DisequalityDispersion.SigEquiv.filteredImage_rename
typeText:
∀ {V F A : Type} {arity : F → Nat} {V' F' : Type} {arity' : F' → Nat}
  (σ : DisequalityDispersion.SigEquiv V F arity V' F' arity') [inst : Fintype.{0} V] [inst_1 : Fintype.{0} V']
  [inst_2 : Fintype.{0} A] (ts : List.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity))
  (tests : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity) (DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity)))
  (I' : DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation F' arity' A),
  Eq.{1}
    (DisequalityDispersion.filteredImage (List.map.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.SigEquiv.rename σ) ts)
      (List.map.{0, 0}
        (fun uv =>
          Prod.mk.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.SigEquiv.rename σ uv.1) (DisequalityDispersion.SigEquiv.rename σ uv.2))
        tests)
      I')
    (DisequalityDispersion.filteredImage ts tests (DisequalityDispersion.SigEquiv.pullI σ I'))

source.code:
theorem filteredImage_rename [Fintype V] [Fintype V'] [Fintype A]
    (ts : List (Term V F arity)) (tests : List (Term V F arity × Term V F arity))
    (I' : Interpretation F' arity' A) :
    filteredImage (ts.map σ.rename) (tests.map (fun uv => (σ.rename uv.1, σ.rename uv.2))) I' =
      filteredImage ts tests (σ.pullI I') := by
  classical
  ext o
  simp only [filteredImage, validAssignments, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun v => a' (σ.eV v), (σ.Valid_rename tests I' a').mp ha', ?_⟩
    simp only [tupleEval, List.map_map]
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro t _
    simp only [Function.comp, eval_rename]
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun v' => a (σ.eV.symm v'), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [σ.Valid_rename tests I']
      simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using ha
    · simp only [tupleEval, List.map_map]
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro t _
      simp only [Function.comp, eval_rename, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
